entities.name: Full name for network
entities.description: An optional information element sent by the network containing the full length name of the network that the UE should associate with the MCC and MNC from the last visited tracking area identification.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may send the Full name for network IE to the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE receives the Full name for network IE and associates it with the MCC and MNC from the last visited tracking area identification.

entities.name: Last visited tracking area identification
entities.description: Contains the MCC and MNC that the UE should associate with the full network name provided in the Full name for network IE.

relations.description: The network may send the Full name for network IE to the UE.
The Full name for network IE is associated by the UE with the MCC and MNC contained in the last visited tracking area identification.
The UE receives and processes the Full name for network IE.
